punchline: In Ruiz's example, a smile at the mall is enough to build a whole relationship in your head without a single word.
thirty_sec: Don Miguel Ruiz describes seeing someone you like at the mall who smiles at you. Before long you assume they like you, picture a relationship and maybe a wedding. He says we do this all the time, expecting partners and friends to read our minds too. An assumption becomes a misunderstanding, then a taken-personally remark, then a big drama for nothing. His fix is to ask until you are clear.
